# Ansible counters (playbooks, and the tasks, handlers, defaults and vars of a role), for a rule
# with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line
# blanks YAML comments and the body of a block scalar (the lines below a | or > that are deeper than
# its key, past a list item's dash, as deep as the first of them; the key stays, so
# "ansible.builtin.shell: |" counts, and an empty scalar blanks no sibling key), so a "- name:" in a shell script
# or a template does not count, and the items of a loop: or with_*: list (the lines below the key
# that are deeper than it, or a list at its depth; the key stays). "plays" counts a hosts: key,
# "named tasks, handlers and plays" every list item that starts with name:, not a loop's item;
# "FQCN module calls" a fully qualified module
# (ansible.builtin.copy:, community.general.ufw:) that is a task's key: a list item
# (- ansible.builtin.copy:) or the key on the line right below the task's name: (its - name: or a
# name: as deep as the module, up to 500 characters long), so a dotted variable of a role's defaults
# (net.ipv4.ip_forward: 1) does not count; a module after another of the task's keys (become: true
# between the name: and the module) is not seen; "loops" loop: and every with_* key; "privilege
# escalation" a become: true or yes in any case, quoted or not; "template expressions" every {{ as
# written ([raw]), so one in a block scalar, which Ansible renders, counts too, and leaves out only
# one in a comment: after a # at a line start or after a blank, at most 200 characters before it.
# OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern
# reads linearly.
[ignore] comments, block scalars and loop items
plays
named tasks, handlers and plays
FQCN module calls
role inclusions
task and playbook inclusions
handler notifications
privilege escalation
conditionals
loops
registered results
vault-encrypted values
[raw] template expressions
